pack: Ledger History and State-Sync in postfiatd
scenario_notes: Each run is a deterministic walk through the pinned rules in two phases. Phase 1, live catch-up: the node follows the live chain to the tip in ceil(gap / 100) doAdvance rounds (MAX_LEDGER_GAP); a run is rejected when a hash check fails (header, state node, transaction node, or zero account hash), and stalled when no peer can serve the data, all peers are stale, or the acquire fails the timeout limit. Phase 2, history backfill: at most the 256 in-window ledgers are fetched (fewer when the best peer serves less), so a run is synced only when the whole gap is backfilled and partial when part of it stays unfetched. Rounds, timeouts, and the 300 s reacquire wait are the only time figures; they come from the pinned constants, not from a live network.
